about.title: From kitchen to code.
about.body: I come from the restaurant world, and I became a developer because I wanted to solve real problems. Since then, I've been building products end to end: a travel app shipped on iOS and Android (STOW), an AI-powered “second brain” for iOS (DUMP — Whisper transcription + Claude classification), a human-led staffing platform for the hospitality industry (EXTRALIMO), and a sales site for a Microsoft solution (Ticketing IT). Mobile (Flutter, Swift/SwiftUI), web (Laravel, Next.js, React) and Microsoft/Power Platform — my throughline is simple: understand the user, ship, iterate, and learn as I build. After two years at Avanade, I keep shipping real projects.
